parent_objective: diagnose L3-vs-L2 seed-3531 public paired counterexample

public_gates: isolate seed-3531 L2-over-L3 rows by surface target and tail offset
compare first-action and terminal-reason differences on negative L3-L2 deltas
check whether seed-3531 counterexample concentrates on event rows or broad rows
do not train or promote checkpoint
forbidden_shortcuts: do not tune L3 using seed-3531 rows
do not hide L2 counterexample when reporting M537/M538
do not promote any baseline from public diagnostic rows
hypothesis: The M538 L3-vs-L2 seed-3531 counterexample can be localized to specific surfaces, offsets, targets, or action/terminal patterns before deciding whether the next step should be longer matched training or finite-window baseline escalation.
success_criteria: seed-3531 negative L3-L2 rows are summarized by surface target tail offset and terminal reason
first-action differences are reported for the largest negative margin rows
event versus non-event contribution is reported
a concrete next decision is selected without training or promotion
failure_criteria: seed-3531 rows cannot be joined back to outcomes
diagnostic treats public rows as private holdout

commands.name: seed3531_counterexample_audit
commands.command: Filter M538 paired deltas to L3_minus_L2 and train_seed 3531; join M537 L2/L3 outcome rows; summarize surfaces, targets, offsets, terminal reasons, event contribution, and first-action deltas.

decision_rule: M539 is a public diagnostic audit. It should decide whether the L3-vs-L2 seed fragility points to training variance, finite-window sufficiency, or a required matched-training recipe change; it does not promote a checkpoint.
